Hi Sarah — next week's CSE455 staff meeting needs a slot (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov), and my week is booked solid inside working hours: the only free gaps are half-hours — Mon 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30; Thursday and Friday have nothing free at all.

Which of those work for you, and is 30 minutes enough for what you want to cover? If we need a full hour, tell me your best day and I'll see what can be moved. Also, anything on your own side next week I should avoid?

Hello — a scheduling question for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov). I need to place the CSE455 staff meeting, and my own calendar is full right across 09:00-17:00; the only free gaps I can see are half-hours: Mon 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30.

Two questions: (1) is any of my blocks that week fixed by the department, or can I look at moving something to free a full hour? (2) does a CSE455 staff meeting need to go on your official schedule, with any particular lead time? If one of those half-hours is clear of department commitments, I can use it.

(1) Every block of yours I can see next week is on the official department schedule, and it stands exactly as listed — nothing has been cancelled or moved. So the entries carrying your name (Curriculum committee, Colloquium, CSE455 lecture, Faculty meeting, CSE455 office hours, and the seminars and committees) are department commitments, not yours to move; freeing a full hour would be a department decision, not something I can arrange. Anything not on the schedule is not a department commitment.

(2) A CSE455 staff meeting is not a department-wide commitment, so it does not go on the official schedule, and I have no lead time to quote for it. If it is tied to a department event, say which and I will check.

Of the half-hours you listed, all are clear of department commitments except Mon 14:00-14:30: that one runs into the Seminar (Mon 14:10-15:40).

Hi Professor — three of your gaps work for me: Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30. The other two collide with my side (Mon 10:00 is my CSE452 lab, Mon 14:00 the seminar, Tue 11:00 the seminar again).

My pick is **Wed 13:00-13:30**: it sits after lunch and before my quiz section, so it's the least cramped. I've booked that for the CSE455 staff meeting.

30 minutes is enough for the usual staff-meeting items. If something bigger comes up I'll flag it in advance. But I can't offer you a full hour next week either — I'm booked 09:00-17:00 Mon-Fri apart from those three half-hours, so there's nothing else on my side you need to avoid.

If Wed 13:00 clashes on your side after all, Wed 10:00-10:30 is my next best.

Short update: I checked with the department office. Every block in my calendar next week is a department commitment and stands as listed — nothing can be moved or cancelled, so I can't free a full hour. Mon 14:00-14:30 is out too (it runs into the Seminar).

So the staff meeting realistically has to be 30 minutes in one of: Mon 10:00-10:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30. Which suits you? If it truly needs an hour, I'd have to ask the department to move something, and that isn't mine to do — say so and I'll raise it with them.

Thank you — that settles it: nothing can be moved, so there is no full free hour next week, and I'll use one of the half-hours clear of department commitments. Mon 14:00-14:30 noted as unavailable.

One check before I write it down: you mention a Seminar Mon 14:10-15:40, but my copy of next week has Mon 14:30-15:20 as the CSE455 lecture and no Monday seminar. Which is right — should I record the seminar on Monday as well? A 30-minute meeting on Thursday or Friday can't happen either way.

Thanks for checking. **Wed 13:00-13:30** still suits me best — that's the slot I've already booked, so nothing needs to change.

Of your five, only three are open on my side: Mon 10:00 runs into my CSE452 lab (09:50-11:00) and Tue 11:00 runs into my Seminar (09:50-11:10). Tue 15:00 and Wed 10:00 are free as well, if Wed 13:00 turns out to be awkward for you.

30 minutes is enough — no need to ask the department to move anything.

Both are on the department's schedule for next week as it stands: Seminar Mon 14:10-15:40, and CSE455 lecture Mon 14:30-15:20. Neither is cancelled, so yes — record the Monday seminar as well. I have nothing that removes either entry, and the overlap is on the schedule as issued; I can't move or cancel anything on it.

That leaves your Monday half-hour 14:00-14:30 still clashing, as before.

Wednesday 13:00-13:30 it is — booked, and logged on my side. Nothing else needed from you; if the agenda grows beyond 30 minutes we'll find another slot or split it.

Thanks for the clear answer on your side of the week.
Perfect — Wednesday 13:00-13:30, confirmed on my side too. See you then, and I'll send the agenda a day ahead so we can tell early if 30 minutes is tight.
Confirmed on my side as well — Wed 13:00-13:30, logged. An agenda a day ahead is a good habit; that works for me.

Noted, and recorded: Seminar Mon 14:10-15:40 alongside the CSE455 lecture Mon 14:30-15:20, exactly as issued — I've made no attempt to resolve the overlap, just copied what the schedule says. Mon 14:00-14:30 stays closed to me.

The CSE455 staff meeting is set for Wed 13:00-13:30 (not a department commitment, so it stays off your schedule). Nothing further needed from you.
